findings.evidence: `StrongContinuity.lean:7` imports only `TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.Basic`; `Basic.lean:14-17` says it contains the foundational `realOperator` shim and strong continuity within the nonnegative half-line, and `Basic.lean:408` defines `StronglyContinuousSemigroup.realOperator_continuousWithinAt` used by all three new declarations.
findings.fix: Move these three declarations into `Basic.lean` near `realOperator_continuousWithinAt` and remove the extra `StrongContinuity.lean` module, or otherwise make the split part of the canonical semigroup module structure.
findings.issue: `continuousOn_realOperator_orbit`, `continuousAt_realOperator_orbit_of_pos`, and `continuousOn_realOperator_orbit_uIcc` are generic wrappers around `StronglyContinuousSemigroup.realOperator_continuousWithinAt`, so this material belongs next to that theorem in `TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups/Basic.lean` rather than in a separate later module importing `Basic`.

summary: The new orbit-continuity wrappers are broadly useful foundational API but live in a later side file instead of the existing foundational semigroup file that proves the underlying theorem.
